title: Grindr推AI新功能，高端订阅月费80美元起
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You're about five months into the debut of some of these new AI features, some of these new subscription tiers that you're testing out.
segments.zh: 这些新AI功能和订阅层级推出大约五个月了，能告诉我们进展如何吗？

segments.en: Can you just update us on how that's going?
So the tests are going really well. The product features are quite popular with users and they work really well.
segments.zh: 测试进展顺利，产品功能很受用户欢迎，效果也很好。

segments.en: The product itself is very tested. We're not trying to figure out what the price should be.
segments.zh: 产品本身经过充分测试，我们不是在摸索定价。

segments.en: We've never launched anything at this price point before. That's very premium focused, small number of users will ever use this product.
segments.zh: 我们从未在这个价位推出过产品，这是非常高端的产品，只有少数用户会使用。

segments.en: And so we've been iterating on what's the best way to position the product and explain it to them.
segments.zh: 我们一直在调整如何定位和解释这个产品。

segments.en: What are you thinking about right now? We tested 80 bucks as the baseline price and that did very well.
segments.zh: 我们现在怎么想的？我们测试了80美元作为基准价，效果很好。

segments.en: Which is 2x our previous price point.
segments.zh: 这是我们之前价格的两倍。

segments.en: We've tested prices all the way up to 375 and there's a broad range of where it might land and we will see.
segments.zh: 我们测试过高达375美元的价格，最终定价可能在一个范围内，我们拭目以待。

segments.en: That is extremely premium. It's very premium.
Tell me about the $80 though. What will that entail if I am paying $80 a month? What am I getting out of it?
segments.zh: 那80美元呢？如果我每月付80美元，我能得到什么？

segments.en: Historically, grinders, premium or paid tiers have given you access to more people.
segments.zh: 历史上，Grindr的付费层级让你能接触到更多人。

segments.en: You would see more people based on how much you pay, extra gets you 500 people, unlimited gets you, unlimited number of people.
segments.zh: 你付的钱越多，看到的人就越多。额外付费能看到500人，无限付费则能看到无限人数。

segments.en: This one gives you a lot more information with the people you see.
segments.zh: 这个层级让你在浏览时获得更多信息。

segments.en: On the profile, you have now AI-generated information about a person.
segments.zh: 在个人资料上，现在有AI生成的信息。
